title: Unsatisfied Cost as an Indicator Sum
statement: For any constraint satisfaction instance and any assignment of domain values to its variables, the total unsatisfied cost equals the sum of the unsatisfaction indicators over its constraints, counting multiplicities.
hypotheses_covered: The instance has a nonempty multiset of constraints

An assignment from variables to domain values
